mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.5% for three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in periods where UNRATE > 5.5% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces earnings growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when GDPC1 declines for two consecutive quarters (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average for three consecutive months signals supply-side weakness, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO is below its 12-month MA for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and a decline in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 2% for two consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance with falling inflation, which typically supports equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises AND CPIAUCSL < 2% for 2 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL < 2% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the unemployment rate above 5.5% and a decline in average weekly hours worked (HOUST) for three consecutive months signals a significant labor market deterioration, which reduces earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 5.5% AND HOUST declines for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 5.5% and HOUST declines for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above its 12-month moving average for three consecutive quarters signals strengthening aggregate demand, which boosts earnings expectations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when GDPC1 is above its 12-month MA for three quarters (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2% for three consecutive months signals a prolonged monetary easing cycle, which supports equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS < 2% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).
